svg.title: How DeckTalk makes a film
svg.desc: Five stations from left to right: the script, the voice, the cues, the slides and the video, each with its file. The script is script.md, one heading a section. The voice reads it and every word gets a time, in a take and its words file. The cues are cues.json, where you name the phrase and the picture starts on it, such as the phrase This is DeckTalk for the cue 1.1title. The slides are plain HTML in deck/index.html, one scene a section. The video is recorded in real time, and every reveal is measured. A line from the slides joins the cues. Under the stations: change one sentence, and only that section is voiced and recorded again. The others keep their takes and their recordings.
svg.text: A script becomes one film, and every picture lands on its word.
Only that section is voiced and recorded again. The others keep their takes and their recordings.
